memory: I believe that maintaining a healthy work-life balance is crucial for success in the finance industry. It's easy to get consumed by the demands of running an investment firm, but it's essential to prioritize family and relationships. My wife has been a constant source of support and encouragement, reminding me that time with loved ones is irreplaceable. I've made a conscious effort to be present and engaged with my children, putting away my phone and focusing on the moment. It's a delicate balance, but one that I believe is essential for achieving true fulfillment in both my personal and professional life.I believe that introducing financial literacy to children can be a fun and engaging experience. My 14-year-old is showing an interest in engineering and is starting to understand the concept of investments and compounding. I set up a small brokerage account in their name and let them track a few stocks. It's great to see them developing an understanding of how money works. My 10-year-old, on the other hand, is more interested in creating a zipline course in our backyard! It's wonderful to see their unique interests and priorities. I want both of them to understand that money is a tool, not an obsession. Financial security is something I've worked hard to provide for them, but I also want them to appreciate the value of hard work, discipline, and resilience. By instilling these values, I hope to raise financially savvy and well-rounded individuals.I believe that the values instilled by my parents have been instrumental in shaping my approach to finance. My dad's experience running a small business taught me the importance of protecting financial security, while my mom's practicality has always emphasized the need to think long-term. Even now, as I work on billion-dollar deals, she still checks in to ensure I'm saving enough. Their influence has given me a deep respect for financial discipline, and I strive to provide for them in their retirement, free from financial stress. It's a reminder that true wealth is not just about accumulating riches but about creating a secure future for those I love.I believe that having a sibling who is immersed in the tech world has been a valuable asset for me. We have a fun dynamic where I handle 'old money' and they focus on building the future. They're always pitching me AI-driven fintech startups, and I'll counter with lessons on risk management. This exchange of ideas keeps me connected to the cutting edge of technology in a personal way. There's a healthy competitiveness between us, but at the end of the day, we both want to see each other succeed. It's rare to have a sibling relationship that blends business insight with mutual respect, and I don't take it for granted.I believe that prioritizing family time is essential, even in the midst of a demanding career. I make sure to set aside specific weekends exclusively for family time, free from work-related activities. My wife and I also try to blend business and leisure by turning international deals into family trips whenever possible. This allows our children to experience different cultures while I fulfill my professional responsibilities. It's a delicate balance, but it's a system that works for us. In the end, no matter how hectic my career gets, my family remains my grounding force. They remind me that wealth is more than just numbers on a balance sheet; it's about having loved ones to share life with.
